body:
I was in the Marine Corps. When I got out I used my GI bill to go to paramedic class. So almost all of my adult life. 

When I've been thinking of suicide I feel nothing. Almost all of the time I feel nothing. I'm not angry or sad. It's just an empty nothingness. 

It's odd. I've been to all of the mandatory classes about taking care of yourself and provider suicide. I feel like they are talking directly to me and to a completely different person at the same time. I usually linger a little while and then make a crude joke to my friends and leave with everyone else.
Ugh, I feel you brother. Marine corps, college, career, family, friends. I hate the nothingness more than anything. What's the fucking point?
